settings.label: Questions per round
settings.help: How many questions a caller is asked before the score page. A pack with fewer questions than this simply makes a shorter round.

settings.label: Question pack
settings.help: The id of one pack in the door's packs/ folder. Leave empty to draw from every installed pack at once. Packs are plain JSON - see packs/README.md for the format.

settings.label: Allow reveal
settings.help: Whether V uncovers the concealed answer on a question page. A revealed question never scores, so this is about whether the option exists at all.
